# 識 + Verb · *sik1 + Verb*

**Meaning:** know how to; can (a learned skill) · **Level:** A2 · **Topic:** Wants, needs and ability

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new).

識 before a verb means you have learned how to do something: speak a language, swim, drive. For learned skills it is more natural than 會, which leans towards 'will'.

**Written Chinese:** 會 — Written Chinese uses 會 for learned ability.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我識講少少廣東話。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 sik1 gong2 siu2 siu2 gwong2 dung1 waa2. |
| Yale | ngóh sīk góng síu síu gwóng dūng wá. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄙㄧㆶ¹ ㄍㄛㄥ² ㄙㄧㄨ² ㄙㄧㄨ² ㄍㄨㄛㄥ² ㄉㄨㄥ¹ ㄨㄚ². |
| English | I can speak a little Cantonese. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你識唔識游水呀？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 jau4 seoi2 aa3? |
| Yale | néih sīk m̀h sīk yàuh séui a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄙㄧㆶ¹ ㆬ⁴ ㄙㄧㆶ¹ ㄧㄜㄨ⁴ ㄙㆤㄧ² ㄚ³? |
| English | Can you swim? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢唔識揸車。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 m4 sik1 zaa1 ce1. |
| Yale | kéuih m̀h sīk jā chē. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㆬ⁴ ㄙㄧㆶ¹ ㄗㄚ¹ ㄘㄝ¹. |
| English | He can't drive. |

## Common mistakes

- ✗ ~~我不會說廣東話。~~ → ✓ **我唔識講廣東話。** *ngo5 m4 sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2.* · *ngóh m̀h sīk góng gwóng dūng wá.*  
  不, 會 and 說 are written forms. Speech uses 唔識講.
